HERO.TITLE: Travel insurance that's clear from the first look
HERO.SUBTITLE: Compare plans by destination, see the full price up front, and get covered before you fly.

DESTINATION.TITLE: Plans by destination
DESTINATION.DESCRIPTION: Pick an Asia or a worldwide plan, and see exactly which countries each one covers.

CLEAR_PRICE.TITLE: One clear price
CLEAR_PRICE.DESCRIPTION: Prices include stamp duty and VAT — what you see is what you pay.

ADDONS.TITLE: Add what you need
ADDONS.DESCRIPTION: Top up your plan with optional cover, such as extra baggage protection.

COVERAGE.TITLE: What our plans cover
COVERAGE.SUBTITLE: Main protections — limits depend on the plan you choose

ITEMS.MEDICAL_EXPENSES: Hospital and treatment costs if you fall ill or get hurt abroad.
ITEMS.ACCIDENTAL_DEATH_DISABILITY: A lump sum for death or permanent disability from an accident.
ITEMS.EMERGENCY_EVACUATION: Transport to the nearest suitable hospital in a medical emergency.
ITEMS.TRIP_CANCELLATION: Non-refundable costs if you must cancel for a covered reason.
ITEMS.FLIGHT_DELAY: Compensation when your flight is delayed beyond the plan's threshold.
ITEMS.BAGGAGE_LOSS: Your belongings, if your baggage is lost or damaged in transit.

DETAILS.TITLE: Enter your trip
DETAILS.DESCRIPTION: Tell us your destination, travel dates and number of travellers.

CHOOSE.TITLE: Choose a plan
CHOOSE.DESCRIPTION: Compare cover and price for your trip, and add optional cover.

POLICY.TITLE: Pay and get your policy
POLICY.DESCRIPTION: Pay online and receive your policy by email.

PRICE.QUESTION: Does the price include tax?
PRICE.ANSWER: Yes. Every price already includes stamp duty and VAT, so there's nothing added at checkout.

PLANS.QUESTION: What's the difference between the plans?
PLANS.ANSWER: Plans differ in where they cover you (for example Asia or worldwide) and how much each protection pays. Compare them side by side on the plans page.

TRAVELLERS.QUESTION: Can I buy for my family or friends?
TRAVELLERS.ANSWER: Yes. One purchase can cover up to 6 travellers on the same trip.

MAX_DAYS.QUESTION: How long can my trip be?
MAX_DAYS.ANSWER: Each plan has its own maximum trip length, shown on the plan card.

ADDONS.QUESTION: Can I add extra cover?
ADDONS.ANSWER: Many plans offer optional add-ons, such as extra baggage or flight-delay cover. You'll find them on each plan's details.

CTA.TITLE: Ready for your next trip?
CTA.SUBTITLE: Enter your destination and travel dates to see your trip's premium.
